build_escnmd_block: build an eSCNMD_Block with edgewise message passing and spectral or grid atomwise feed-forward layers
create_edgewise_module: create an Edgewise module with SO2 convolution layers and gate or S2 activation for edge message passing
create_spectral_atomwise: create a SpectralAtomwise module using SO3 linear layers and gate activation for atom-wise transformations
create_grid_atomwise: create a GridAtomwise module that projects to SO3 grid, applies MLP, and projects back to spherical harmonics
set_mole_ac_start_index: set the activation checkpointing start index on all MOLE submodules within a given PyTorch module
